Department of Gender Studies, 5th Floor, Zakir Hussain Block, NCERT, Sri Aurobindo Marg, New Delhi

content_sections.heading: NCERT Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. 4.01/2026-27/PAC Prog./DGS gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download NCERT notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Post-Graduation in Science/Statistics/Mathematics/Commerce/Economics Education/Computer Science/Computer Application with minimum 55% marks; Graduate with 55% marks and two-year PG Diploma in Computer Application Experience: Five Years' experience in management of large-scale survey data management and data analysis. Age limit: Not more than 45 years/not more than 65 years in case of retired person from Government Organization Age relaxation: retired government person Not more than 65 years Desirable: Working knowledge of data analysis software like -SPSS, R, Python, Bilog, ConQuest etc. and IRT.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Two Months tenure Purely on temporary basis

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Resume/Bio-Data Original and self-attested copies of certificates One passport size photograph Attested copy of the salary slip/bank statement/ITR where the experience forms as one of the essential eligibility conditions

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NCERT Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Attend the walk-in-interview on 05 November, 2026 in the Department of Gender Studies. Bring Resume/Bio-Data along with original and self-attested copies of certificates and one passport size photograph. Attend on 5 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Registration will be up to 11:30 AM only. Candidates working with other organization should forward the application through their employer or submit a 'No objection Certificate' before the interview. No TA/DA will be paid by NCERT for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q1. When is the walk-in interview for NCERT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 5 November 2026.
